$comment: Project settings for the autonomous experiment workflow.
These rules are POLICY, not enforcement. An agent with Bash access runs as the same
user and could work around them. The only load-bearing safety layer is the external
guard started by tools/setup_guard.sh, which runs from a copy of its code outside this
repository. What these rules buy is that a mistake becomes a blocked call instead of a
silent charge, and that tampering becomes deliberate rather than accidental.

$comment_ask: tools/ and deploy/ are 'ask' rather than 'deny' on purpose. 'deny' has no appeal,
which would stop the human from maintaining their own tooling in an interactive
session. In an UNATTENDED session there is nobody to answer the prompt, so an ask is
effectively a block — the same protection where it matters. And a change that does get
approved is still caught at the next gate, because the reviewer verifies
tools/checksums.sha256 and the git state of tools/ and deploy/ before any rung passes.
